meta.title: Tyche — Verdant
meta.description: Houseplants, filed by light, built by importing the Verdant starter into a fresh WooCommerce store.
meta.author: colorlib

options.blogdescription: Plants for the room you actually have

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$state = tyche_companion_import_start( 'verdant' );
if ( is_wp_error( $state ) ) { echo 'start failed: ' . $state->get_error_message(); return; }
for ( $i = 0; $i < 400; $i++ ) {
	$state = tyche_companion_import_step();
	if ( is_wp_error( $state ) ) { echo 'step failed: ' . $state->get_error_message(); break; }
	if ( ! empty( $state['complete'] ) ) { break; }
}
